steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Catholic Christians also believe in purgatory — a state of purification after death for those who will eventually enter heaven but need to be cleansed of venial sins.

steps.title: RS Exam Tips — The Afterlife
steps.body: 1. For The Afterlife questions, always include specific scriptural or source references where relevant 2. Explain both religious and non-religious viewpoints 3. Use specialist vocabulary precisely (e.g. terms from the specification) 4. Evaluate by analysing strengths and weaknesses of different views before reaching your conclusion 5. Link your discussion of The Afterlife to its real-world impact on believers and society

steps.title: Try it yourself
steps.body: Q: Explain two Christian beliefs about the afterlife. | Q: "Belief in the afterlife gives life meaning." Evaluate this statement.

steps.title: Check your answers

steps.title: Exam tips
steps.body: Always refer to specific sources of authority (scripture, sacred texts, religious leaders) Explain contrasting beliefs — different views within and between traditions Use key terminology precisely (e.g. tawhid, atonement, sanctity of life) For 12-mark evaluation questions, consider both sides before reaching a justified conclusion Link beliefs to their impact on individuals, communities and society Acknowledge diversity — no religious tradition has a single, uniform view
